preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): 1 <= len(ladders[i]) <= 15 and 1 <= len(snakes[i]) <= 15
preconditions.description: Each test case has between 1 and 15 ladders and snakes.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): for ladder in ladders[i]: 1 <= ladder[0] < ladder[1] <= 100
preconditions.description: Each ladder starts and ends within the board and goes up only.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): for snake in snakes[i]: 1 <= snake[0] > snake[1] <= 100
preconditions.description: Each snake starts and ends within the board and goes down only.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): not (1 in [ladder[0] for ladder in ladders[i]] + [snake[0] for snake in snakes[i]]) and not (100 in [ladder[1] for ladder in ladders[i]] + [snake[1] for snake in snakes[i]])
preconditions.description: Neither square 1 nor square 100 is the starting point of a ladder or snake.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): len(set([ladder[0] for ladder in ladders[i]] + [snake[0] for snake in snakes[i]] + [ladder[1] for ladder in ladders[i]] + [snake[1] for snake in snakes[i]])) == len([ladder[0] for ladder in ladders[i]] + [snake[0] for snake in snakes[i]] + [ladder[1] for ladder in ladders[i]] + [snake[1] for snake in snakes[i]])
preconditions.description: No square has more than one endpoint from either a snake or a ladder.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(t): return_value[i] >= 0 or return_value[i] == -1
postconditions.description: Each test case returns either a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of moves or -1 if there is no solution.
